test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The radius of a hemisphere is 21 cm. Its volume (in cm³) will be:

(Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given data:**

Radius (r) of the hemisphere = 21 cm

**Concept or formula:**

Volume of a hemisphere = 2/3πr³

**Calculation:**

Substitute the given values in the formula

⇒ Volume = 2/3 × 22/7 × 21³ = 19404 cm³

**Hence, the volume of the hemisphere is 19404 cm³.**
